Two rosters, one generated file

The repo-root plugin.json is a byte mirror of plugins/ork/plugin.json, emitted by the build so scanners crawling GitHub find it. Two mechanisms own generated version fields: release-please extra-files (bumps them on release) and the CI drift roster (fails if a committed generated file differs from a fresh build). Toggle the fix to see what each mechanism does to the mirror when a release lands.
